messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: P1 incident created — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (region: us-west). Pager routed to @alex. auto-bridge: #incidents

alex: seeing it. 5xx spike across 3 nodes. paging in progress. grabbing logs now. anyone oncall but me?

sarah: I'm available to help with customer comms and timelines.

mike: pulling inference runtime logs and kernel traces. will paste tail.

ops-bot: deploy detected: autoscaler bumped pool from 8->12 at 14:02 UTC (deploy id: d-9f3).

alex: ok timeline start — 13:57 UTC gradual increase in latency, 14:02 autoscaler activity, 14:05 5xx spike. hypothesis 1: autoscaler caused transient kernel mismatch or cache thrash. hypothesis 2: KV cache OOM on long prefix.

lina: copying logs to share: s3://redwood-incidents/1861234567/logs/ (grepable). second link: https://kibana.redwood/1861234567

mike: logs (excerpt):
```
2026-03-15T14:04:58Z ERROR runtime: inference kernel mismatch detected for model Llama2-13B
2026-03-15T14:05:03Z WARN kvcache: prefix-cache allocation failed: requested 1.2GB, available 512MB
2026-03-15T14:05:04Z ERROR http: handler crashed: runtime error: index out of range
```

alex: that kvcache line looks bad. also seeing OOMs in dmesg on node gpu-06. can we roll back the recent kernel/quantization patch?

sarah: drafting status page. short blurb proposal:
"We are investigating elevated errors for the Text Generation API (US-West). Some customers may experience increased 5xx rates. Mitigation in progress; updates every 30 minutes."

product-led: +1 concise. please add ETA for next update slot.

elaine: FYI several customers reported degraded throughput to support. cc @support.

ops-bot: mitigation actions taken: - scaled down new pool nodes (rollback to 8) at 14:12 UTC; - restarted inference service on gpu-06; - pinned model variant to v1.2 at 14:14 UTC.

alex: live mitigation notes: restart reduced 5xx on gpu-06 but spike persisted on gpu-03. opening bridge to async RCA work. need hypothesis tracking in this thread.

mike: hypothesis A: kernel/driver update on new nodes incompatible with optimized kernels -> mismatched execution path -> crash. supporting log: "kernel mismatch detected".

lina: hypothesis B: prefix KV cache pressure due to anomalous long-context requests from a single tenant. shared grep: top IPs -> 10.4.92.33 high token counts.

alex: @sarah can you sync with support for customer impact list and which tenants saw 5xx? we need customer severity for comms.

sarah: already on it. have a list from support; will attach redacted list to the timeline doc in ~15m.

product-led: for statuspage, please include whether mitigation reduced errors and next steps. example:
"Mitigation applied: service restarts and rollback to previous node image. Observed partial recovery; engineering continues root cause analysis."

alex: ops checklist for handoff to async:
- capture kernel logs + dmesg from affected nodes (done, uploaded)
- export perf traces for 13:50-14:20 window (in progress)
- annotate top customer requests (sarah/support)
- assign RCA owner (sarah)
- schedule follow-up async sync (within 24h)

ops-bot: perf trace export completed: s3://redwood-incidents/1861234567/traces/trace-14-20.tar.gz

mike: dropping a small grepable bundle here:
```
# top offenders by prefix length
tenant-42  1200 reqs, avg tokens 4.2k
tenant-88  430 reqs, avg tokens 3.9k
```

lina: adding manual timeline notes to doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/1861234567/timeline (editable). please add short notes about what you accepted/did.

alex: readying the handoff message for async: include current mitigation state, artifacts (logs/traces), owner, and immediate next steps. Draft below — please edit:
"We reduced 5xx incidents by restarting affected nodes and rolling back the new node image. Partial recovery observed; persistent errors remain on gpu-03. Artifacts: logs + traces in s3. RCA owner: Sarah. Next steps: analyze perf traces for kernel mismatch and KV cache behavior; correlate with tenant long-context requests. Follow-up update in 24h."

product-led: tweak: change 'partial recovery' -> 'partial restoration of service for most customers'.

sarah: I'll own the RCA and timeline. I'll take the perf traces and correlate with tenant request patterns; expected ETA for initial RCA draft: 48 hours.

alex: assigning async action items:
- sarah: RCA owner, draft postmortem and timeline (48h)
- mike: deep kernel/log analysis, root cause candidate (24h)
- lina: compile customer impact list and redacted request samples (24h)
- product-led: prepare external comms draft for customers and status page language (by EOD)

ops-bot: alert: Pager duty incident will be closed in 30m if no further spike.

alex: starting handoff now — moving to async. final live note: keep thread updated if any re-escalation. thanks all. :thumbsup:

sarah: adding initial RCA template and sections to the doc. will ping when first draft is ready.

mike: one more note: we saw increased GC pauses in the runtime at 14:03 which may have amplified cache pressure. adding that to hypotheses.

product-led: tracking comm deliverables: statuspage draft posted to doc; will coordinate with comms for timing.

elaine: support will send affected customer list and suggested mitigation steps for customer engineering teams.

alex: closing live bridge. next update via doc and async thread. incident-bot: please post a summary to #incidents-archive after closure.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Transitioned to async RCA. Owner: sarah. Artifacts: logs, traces, timeline doc.

sarah: thanks everyone. assigning myself as PM for this RCA. will follow up with a schedule and initial hypotheses matrix.
